system.description: Ordinary human using the standard campaign baseline. Customize this owned Form for your character.
system.rules: No special Form exceptions. Standard movement is 15 ft. Set Max HP to suit your campaign, or leave it blank to copy the character’s current maximum when applied.

weaponActions.name: Unarmed Strike
weaponActions.description: Strike a target within 5 ft using a free hand or limb. Roll Melee Combat plus an optional Unarmed Focus; damage is applied separately.
